target.title: build: update PostgreSQL coordinator dependencies
target.body:
## Summary

- update `pg` from 8.21.0 to 8.22.0
- update `pg-boss` from 12.18.2 to 12.25.1 and refresh its compatible cron/parser lock graph
- include current protocol parsing, startup retry, queue-cache, migration-deadlock, and scheduling fixes in the Node/PostgreSQL coordinator
- add the `0.35.1 - Unreleased` changelog entry

## Verification

- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run check:node --prefix worker`
- `npm test --prefix worker` — 26 files, 787 tests passed
- `npm run build --prefix worker`
- `npm run build:node --prefix worker`
- `npm audit --prefix worker --omit=dev` — 0 vulnerabilities
- autoreview — clean, no actionable findings

Local Node 26 required `npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefix worker` because the unchanged `sharp` package lacks a Node 26 prebuild and its optional source-build helper. The changed PostgreSQL packages have no install scripts; hosted CI uses the repository-pinned Node 24 path.

## Exact-head live proof

Built commit `5a448b9873dcbfe5fd7774ba7192e4844ca0a326` and started the real Node coordinator against a disposable PostgreSQL 16 container.

- `/v1/ready` returned `{"ok":true}`
- `crabbox` and `crabbox_jobs` schemas were created
- `coordinator-alarm` and `coordinator-reconcile` queues were created
- the 15-minute reconciliation schedule was installed
- the startup reconciliation job reached `completed`
- SIGINT produced a graceful coordinator exit with status 0
- the PostgreSQL container and coordinator listener were absent after cleanup

No persistent credentials or external resources were used.
